title: Top Carry-On Bags That Fit Every Airline (2026)
summary: Top carry‑on bags that fit every airline are the Travelpro Platinum Elite, Away Carry‑On, Béis The Carry‑On, and Quince Carry‑On, chosen for their repeated endorsement and airline‑friendly dimensions.
method: I selected products mentioned in more than one source, prioritizing those with multiple citations. Sources used: Consumer Reports (1), PCMag (2), OutdoorGearLab (3), Business Insider (4).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the excerpts, so all price fields are null. No discount information was found, so deal_note is null.

products.name: Travelpro Platinum Elite Expandable Carry‑On
why: The Travelpro Platinum Elite is highlighted as the best overall carry‑on by both OutdoorGearLab and Business Insider, praised for its spaciousness, sturdy construction, and organizational features.
It has a 40‑liter main compartment, expandable area, and is favored by frequent fliers for its durability and smooth roll.
products.best_for: Frequent fliers who need a reliable, spacious carry‑on
products.skip_if: You need a very lightweight or ultra‑budget option

products.name: Away Carry‑On
why: PCMag notes the Away Carry‑On is the least expensive battery‑equipped smart suitcase at $225, offering a 10,000mAh battery and two charging ports.
OutdoorGearLab lists it as a durable hard‑shell option that performs well above its price tag, with a clean interior organization.
specs: TSA lock integrated into zipper pull
products.best_for: Budget travelers who want a smart suitcase with charging capability
products.skip_if: You need a very rugged or high‑capacity bag

products.name: Béis The Carry‑On
why: Business Insider recommends Béis for extra space, calling it an expandable bag with a massive interior capacity.
OutdoorGearLab also lists it as a recommendation for travelers needing more room.
products.best_for: Over‑packers who need extra room in a carry‑on
products.skip_if: You prefer a hard‑shell or lightweight bag
